understanding: Abdominal ultrasound walkthrough covering liver, gallbladder, pancreas and spleen with labeled and unannotated scan examples.

tasks.question: Do the large color Doppler patches lie inside the long dark gallbladder lumen or beside it?
tasks.reference_answer: They lie beside it. The conspicuous blue and orange patches sit outside the dark lumen near its lower-right end.
tasks.visual_support: The dark elongated lumen is outlined by tissue and the conspicuous color patches are outside it.
tasks.query_prefix_check: Both the lumen and colored regions are visible at the query.
tasks.answer_prefix_check: The patches can be located relative to the lumen boundary.
tasks.shortcut_risk: Moderate. Color alone does not locate the patches relative to the lumen.

tasks.question: When the next gallbladder view appears, how does the long axis of the dark lumen change on screen?
tasks.reference_answer: It goes from slanting downward to the right to slanting upward to the right.
tasks.visual_support: The Doppler view through 313 slopes from upper left to lower right. The grayscale view at 314 slopes in the opposite direction.
tasks.query_prefix_check: Only the initial orientation is visible at 312.
tasks.answer_prefix_check: The new grayscale view shows the reversed slope by 314.
tasks.shortcut_risk: Low. The plane labels do not specify the screen slope.

tasks.question: In the earlier annotated aorta view, was the pancreas outline above or below the large red aorta overlay?
tasks.reference_answer: It was above the red aorta overlay, toward the upper right of the annotated scan.
tasks.visual_support: The outlined pancreas lies above the red aorta and to the right of the outlined left liver lobe.
tasks.query_prefix_check: The annotated aorta view precedes the spleen scan.
tasks.answer_prefix_check: The earlier overlay shows the relative position directly.
tasks.shortcut_risk: Moderate. The anatomy can provide a clue.

review_scope: Same-assistant review; sampled timeline, original-size key frames, and existing time-indexed ASR when available. No continuous replay or direct audio claim.
